Journeys start even before you actually start…

Established in 2018 as a direct-to-consumer cosmeceutical brand, Re’equil stands for restoring the lost equilibrium of skin, hair, expectations and results. This is how our journey began. Since then, we’ve been constantly moving forward and helping you move forward in your journey.

settings.left_side_content:
Re’storing Equilibrium

Not just for your skin and hair, but also for your trust…

Equilibrium is a state in which one feels a sense of balance. Re’equil stands for Restoring Equilibrium and the desire to restore equilibrium comes from the desire to move forward. We help you move forward with efficacy driven & safety tested products that are formulated keeping you in mind and that set the right expectations.
